statement: BSE notice 20251212-8 (12 Dec 2025), 'Trading Holidays for the Calendar Year 2026 for Equity and Equity Derivatives Segments', amended by BSE notice 20260112-8 (12 Jan 2026) closing the Equity Segment on 15 January 2026. 'The Exchange may alter / change any of the above holidays, for which a separate circular shall be issued in advance.' No BSE 2027 list was found, so the horizon ends on 2026-12-31.

sources.covers: 2026 trading holidays (15 weekday holidays and 4 holidays on Saturday/Sunday); '*Muhurat Trading will be conducted on Sunday, November 08, 2026. Timings of Muhurat Trading shall be notified subsequently.'
'on account of Municipal Corporation Election scheduled to be held on January 15, 2026, the following trading segments will remain closed on January 15, 2026. Equity Segment ...'

holidays: Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev

special_sessions.label: Diwali Muhurat Trading session (Diwali Laxmi Pujan)
special_sessions.notes: BSE announced the session (notice 20251212-8) but its timing notice could not be retrieved from bseindia.com on 2026-10-22, so the times and the settlement statement are recorded as unknown. session() raises SessionTimeUnknown for this date. ICCL settles trades of this date on the ICCL-EQ calendar.

notes: No regular_session: BSE's trading-hours page is a script-rendered application whose data service (api.bseindia.com) refused automated retrieval (HTTP 403) on 2026-10-22. session() raises SessionTimeUnknown until a BSE source is recorded.

Verification gap: BSE's live holiday list (https://www.bseindia.com/static/markets/marketinfo/listholi, data from api.bseindia.com) returned HTTP 403, and BSE notice pages dated after early March 2026 were not rendered server-side, so a BSE amendment published after March 2026 would not be reflected here. Cross-check only (not a BSE source): the NSE equity list retrieved the same day has the same dates.
Sunday 2026-11-08 is a holiday with an explicit Muhurat special session whose times are unknown; it is never an ordinary trading day.
Settlement dates for BSE trades are counted on the ICCL-EQ calendar (Indian Clearing Corporation Ltd).
